assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE new transparent square ink doodle for a portfolio, a close frontal portrait of the tiny light from the game in reference 1. Reference 2 (teacup) shows exactly how to draw the lines, not the subject. Draw the light large with its distinctive almost round glass bulb, narrowing just slightly where it meets a plain squat SQUARE lamp base directly beneath. In the glass a single short upright wick/filament. The chunky plain squared off base is essential (not a ridged household screw fitting, no hanging cable or floor). A simple inner rim/short reflection can suggest curved glass. The light is switched on! Reinterpret the game's broad concentric light bloom using two widely spaced, incomplete, hand-drawn circular halo arcs concentric around the whole lamp, offset openings, and two or three short little glints in the openings. Let the negative space breathe. Center lamp approximately half the full drawing height; the halos must surround it recognizably and read as light rather than a solid enclosure. Match the style ref's deep peacock-green #086B68 slightly imperfect rounded felt-tip strokes, medium-bold sculptural outline, simple geometry. Halo arcs a little finer than main drawing. Zero other ink colors. Empty unfilled interiors; true transparent alpha background everywhere including the glass, the halo, and the base. Square canvas, complete centered composition filling 82% of canvas with balanced margins. Readable at 90px. No black scene, fill, gradients, 3d, hatch, shadows, faces, text, watermark or page mockup.

assets.prompt: Create a minimal ink portrait of the ACTUAL small game model in the first reference, enlarged and translated literally into the single deep peacock-green hand-drawn outline style of the second image. This is a likeness correction: make a recognizable block-built cyber cat as modeled in old OpenGL, perched standing on a flying cloud. The cat's anatomy is built of separate simple primitives: a plain, modest round/spherical head (about the same width as the chest), two small pointed triangular ears, a short WIRE-OUTLINED CUBOID torso seen from the front, two LONG slim straight rectangular front legs with flat square feet spaced apart standing on top of the cloud. Narrow upright silhouette. Cat height about 45–50% of the whole composition, cat head width roughly 20% of cloud width. Do not use a giant kitten head or depict short round paws hanging over the cloud. The tail is the other very distinctive detail: a single trail of 6 separate little round bead segments, large at the base and tapering to tiny at the far tip, arcing upward to the side and BEHIND the head at viewer's LEFT as in screenshot. Alternate outlined and solid beads in same ink. View full on, both eyes visible as two tiny dots and otherwise spare plain face. NO whiskers, mouth, drawn fur, toes, collar, armor, clothes, stripes, or other mascot embellishments. The cat should look like a tiny strange geometric creature made for this particular game. Wide flattened flying cloud assembled from an oval mass and three big overlapping sphere puffs, with a smaller round lobe bulging down and forward slightly right of center. Below the cloud ONE swooping oblique halo ring higher at left and lower at right, front arc in front of and below the cloud, back edge hidden; three simple strokes fan downward under the ring to show the thruster light. Focus on line quality: relaxed rounded felt-tip peacock-green outlines, gently hand-drawn imperfect lines with rounded ends and clean closed shapes. Unfilled shapes with transparent interiors and real transparent background just like second reference, no white or gradient. 1:1 square canvas, both paws and all rays visible, 9% margin all around. Enough breathing space to recognize all at 104px. Only draw the cat and cloud and light, no city, text, photo border or environment.

assets.prompt: Precise edit of image 1, the current transparent one-color portfolio pen drawing. Image 2 is the actual game character seen from behind, for orientation. Make only two changes to the existing doodle. (1) Turn the little geometric cyber cat on top of the cloud around 180 degrees into a straight-on BACK VIEW. Show the smooth blank back of its head with the two pointed ears seen from behind, the square back and rump, two straight hind legs and square feet. Its distinctive raised, bead-segmented tail must visibly originate at the center of its lower back/rump ON THE VIEWER-FACING SIDE, curving up and to the viewer's left in front of its back, tapering into little spaced beads at the tip. This rear attachment visually distinguishes the turned cat from just an erased face. No facial features, eyes or inner ears visible. Keep the existing cat's scale or a touch larger, same simple geometric proportions, and put both feet visibly on top of the cloud. (2) UNDERNEATH the tilted orbital ring, draw exactly THREE unmistakably LONG slightly flaring slender light strokes, like a small fan of emitted light: one longer middle upright stroke and two similarly long outward diagonal strokes, just three isolated single ink strokes with round ends, nothing further under them. The existing version has three short ticks; extend them to nearly TWICE their former length relative to the cloud width. Leave a visible gap between the ring and the top of each ray. Make room for the longer rays by moving the drawing up slightly or redistributing blank margins, keeping the whole icon visible with clear margins. Preserve the existing puffy cloud shape with the round forward lobe, its one tilted elliptical orbit high on left low on right, legible outline, and the exact original deep peacock-green rounded, gently hand-drawn pen-line style. Single green ink, no fill inside the outlines, fully transparent RGBA background throughout including inside the cat and cloud. Square composition for thumbnail use. No ground, text, scenery, glows made of gradients, embellishment or added sparkles.

Precise small edit to the attached transparent peacock-green pen drawing. Keep the original back-facing geometric cat with raised beaded tail, its standing pose on the same puffy cloud, the same tilted orbit, the same entire composition and pen stroke weight as close to the original as possible. Make ONLY two localized changes. A: under the orbit there are presently three long standalone rays: left diagonal, straight vertical center, right diagonal. Erase the straight vertical center ray completely to transparency. Keep the two existing long diagonal rays in their original places unchanged. There must be exactly TWO long lines underneath, pointing down and out with open space in between. B: in the air BESIDE the illustration, scatter about 8 isolated irregular small solid peacock-green ink dots to evoke drifting game particles, four or five left of the upper part of the cloud, three or four to the right of the upper part of the cloud. Asymmetric grouping, mix of small and medium pinpricks, gently imperfect round shapes, irregular spacing with open space, a couple of tiny companion dots close to a larger one. Sized to be recognizable when the image is on a website at 104 CSS pixels (diameters roughly 13-32px on a 1254px source). Position them outside the silhouette with an air gap, in the quieter side spaces, detached from the beaded tail and from the ring. Nothing in the area below the ring except the TWO long diagonal rays. No stars, dashes, outlined bubbles, sprays of tiny dust, or extra words. Do not redraw other parts, do not crop. Preserve original square framing, true transparent background and unfilled interiors, same single deep peacock-green ink.
